column4: Your opponents have limited Stamina. When their Stamina is exhausted, they won't be able to fight as effectively.
Pay attention to the color of your enemies' level numbers. Green means they are close to your level. Red means they are a challenge, and a skull icon means they are deadly.
Sharpening your blade on a grindstone will enhance its combat capabilities.
Strike an opponent while riding towards him at high speed for an increased damage.
Striking from behind increases you critical hit chances.
When throwing a bomb or shooting a bolt from your crossbow, you can either take advantage of auto-aiming for a quick attack, or aim manually for better damage.
You can deflect incoming bolts and arrows with your sword.
You can use Quen to protect from critical effects such as Burning, Bleeding, etc.
Dodging is usually the best tactic when fighting huge monsters. When fighting humans and smaller monsters, try to parry and counter their attacks with your sword.
